IGUI_GS_ProgramTabletDiskDesc: Adds the GS WiFi Antenna peripheral to a terminal in this network: remote tablet access.
IGUI_GS_AddonTabletDesc: Tablet add-on: magazine required (Electricity 5). Install module on this terminal.
IGUI_GSSiK_RemoteNetworksHelp: The tablet lists only networks you belong to. The antenna installed in each network determines its coverage.
IGUI_GSSiK_RemoteLoadingHelp: Membership, an active terminal, the installed antenna and coverage are checked before each network is listed.
IGUI_GSSiK_RemoteEmptyHelp: Only networks you belong to and which retain an active terminal are listed.
IGUI_GSSiK_RemoteOutdatedTitle: The network is no longer available
IGUI_GSSiK_RemoteOutdatedHelp: The network is checked again when opened; access, terminal, antenna or coverage changes invalidate the previous selection.
IGUI_GSSiK_RemoteErrorHelp: A response failure never grants access or reuses a previous selection.
IGUI_GSSiK_RemoteLoading: Checking remote access for this tablet...
IGUI_GSSiK_RemoteEmpty: No network is currently reachable. Check membership, active terminals and antenna coverage.
IGUI_GSSiK_RemoteOutdated: The selected network changed. Refresh the list before opening it.
IGUI_GSSiK_RemoteError: The network list could not be obtained. Try again.
